Cyklus: manipulace od otevírací ceny: Cycle: manipulation from the opening price
Devadesátiminutový cyklus, ve kterém ček: A ninety-minute cycle in which you expect a drop.
Začíná nový devadesátiminutový cyklus. O: A new ninety-minute cycle begins. The opening price is 110 and the last cycle's low at 104 remains below price.
Manipulace. Cena nejdřív vyjede nad otev: Manipulation. Price first runs above the opening price. Whoever jumps on the rally leaves a stop below it.
Obrat. Silné svíčky se vrátí pod otevíra: Reversal. Strong candles return below the opening price. The cycle high is in and the direction is down.
Distribuce. Po malém návratu cena dojde: Distribution. After a small retracement price reaches the last cycle's low. That was the target from the start.
Nejdřív falešný pohyb proti směru od ote: First a false move against the direction from the opening price, then the real move to the last cycle's liquidity.
Směr dne je nahoru. Čekáš falešný výpad: The day's direction is up. You expect a false push down at the market open.
Před otevřením burzy cena přešlapuje. Sm: Before the market opens price treads water. The day's direction is up and the target is the previous session's high at 111.
9:30. Hned po otevření cena spadne pod o: 9:30. Right after the open price falls below the opening price and below the consolidation low. That is the Judas swing: a false move against the day's direction that takes the stops.
Obrat. Dvě silné svíčky vrátí cenu nad o: Reversal. Two strong candles bring price back above the opening price. Whoever bought below it bought at a discount.
Setup. Vstup při návratu k otevírací cen: Setup. Entry on the return to the opening price at 100.4. Stop below the low of the push at 95.3.
Target. Price reaches the previous session's high. The risk is 5.1 points and the profit 10.6 points, that is over 2R. This is what a trade looks like where both time and price fit. But it often fails, which is why every attempt is logged and counted.
Směr dne, falešný výpad v 9:30 proti něm: The day's direction, a false push against it at 9:30, a return above the opening price, the entry, the stop below the push, the target at liquidity.
Jeden býčí den a čtyři otevírací ceny v: One bullish day and four opening prices in New York time. Watch how price behaves around them.
18:00. Otevírá nový obchodní den na futu: 18:00. A new trading day opens on futures. The opening price of 100 is the first guide: above it the day is so far in the plus, below it in the minus.
00:00. Půlnoční otevírací cena dělí den: 00:00. The midnight opening price divides the day into premium and discount. On a day when you expect a rally, you look for a buy below it.
9:30. Burza otevírá na 98,5 a cena hned: 9:30. The market opens at 98.5 and price drops right away. It is below all three opening prices, that is deep in discount.
Obrat. Silné svíčky vrátí cenu nad oteví: Reversal. Strong candles bring price back above the 9:30 opening price and above the midnight one. Levels that were above price turn into support.
10:00. Začíná další cyklus. Cena se od n: 10:00. Another cycle begins. From it price returns down to the midnight and evening opening prices and stops there. Several levels meet in one place.
Od shluku otevíracích cen cena pokračuje: From the cluster of opening prices price continues up. The more levels meet in one place, the more weight the entry has. But none of them gives certainty.
Pod otevírací cenou je discount, nad ní: Below the opening price is discount, above it premium. Look for a buy below it and a sell above it, ideally where several opening prices meet.
Market maker buy model: tři vstupy: Market maker buy model: three entries
Celý nákupní model na jednom grafu: levá: The whole buy model on one chart: the left side of the curve down, the reversal and the right side up.
Původní konsolidace. Tady model začíná a: The original consolidation. The model starts here and also ends here: the buy model is complete once price returns above it.
Levá strana křivky. Cena klesá k cíli na: The left side of the curve. Price falls to the higher-timeframe target and makes two retracements on the way. Remember them, they will be useful on the right side.
Smart money reversal. Cena vybere low př: Smart money reversal. Price takes the previous cycle's low and falls no further. This is where the big players buy.
Zlom struktury. Dvě silné svíčky prorazí: Structure break. Two strong candles break the high of the second retracement. The direction has turned up.
První vstup: low-risk buy. Nákup při prv: First entry: the low-risk buy. A buy on the first retracement after the break, stop below its low. It is the best price, but the reversal is not certain yet.
Druhý vstup. Cena se vrátí k úrovni prvn: Second entry. Price returns to the level of the first retracement from the left side and it now holds as support. If it didn't hold, the model is no longer valid.
Dokončení. Cena se vrátí nad původní kon: Completion. Price returns above the original consolidation. The last entry tends to be just before it, with the least profit left.
Konsolidace, pokles se dvěma návraty, ob: Consolidation, a drop with two retracements, a reversal at liquidity, a structure break, entries on retracements and a target above the original consolidation.
